title: PP2 suppresses proliferation and migration of C6 Glioma and MDA-MB-231 cells by targeting both fibroblast growth factor receptor 1 and Src.
authors: Yang, Yanyan; Tang, Ningning; Liu, Yan; Choi, Wooram; Kim, Ji Hye; Kim, Han Gyung; Yu, Tao; Cho, Jae Youl
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PP2抑制剂对胶质瘤和乳腺癌细胞增殖迁移的抑制机制，涉及FGFR1/Src激酶和分子对接，但核心是激酶-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Fibroblast growth factor (FGF) is involved in the progression of glioma, a most common type of brain tumor, and breast tumors. In this study, we aim to evaluate the effects of the inhibitor PP2 on cell proliferation and migration in glioma and breast tumor cells, and to characterize the molecular mechanisms involved in these processes. The inhibitory effect of PP2 on the tumorigenic potential of C6 glioma and MDA-MB-231 cells was examined by proliferation, migration, and invasion assays, and apoptotic analysis. The molecular mechanism behind the anti-glioma activity of PP2 was investigated by immunoblotting, immunoprecipitation, phosphoprotein assay, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and molecular docking modeling. PP2 suppressed the proliferation and migration of C6 glioma and MDA-MB-231 cells via FGF2. Moreover, PP2 directly blocked the enzyme activity of FGF receptor 1 (FGFR1) and Src, subsequently affecting the nuclear factor-kappaB and activator protein-1 signaling pathways. CETSA analysis and the docking model indicated that the TK1 domains (Val 492 ad Glu 486) of FGFR2 could be binding sites of PP2. Collectively, therefore, our findings suggest that PP2 mediates antitumor effects by targeting both FGFR1 and Src and may have applications as a therapeutic inhibitor for the treatment of glioma.
abstract_zh: 成纤维细胞生长因子（FGF）参与胶质瘤（一种最常见的脑肿瘤类型）及乳腺肿瘤的进展。本研究旨在评估抑制剂PP2对胶质瘤和乳腺肿瘤细胞增殖与迁移的影响，并表征这些过程中涉及的分子机制。通过增殖、迁移和侵袭实验及凋亡分析，检测了PP2对C6胶质瘤和MDA-MB-231细胞致瘤潜能的抑制作用。采用免疫印迹、免疫沉淀、磷酸化蛋白分析、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和分子对接模型，研究了PP2抗胶质瘤活性背后的分子机制。PP2通过FGF2抑制了C6胶质瘤和MDA-MB-231细胞的增殖与迁移。此外，PP2直接阻断FGF受体1（FGFR1）和Src的酶活性，进而影响核因子-κB和激活蛋白-1信号通路。CETSA分析和对接模型表明，FGFR2的TK1结构域（Val 492和Glu 486）可能是PP2的结合位点。因此，综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，PP2通过靶向FGFR1和Src介导抗肿瘤效应，并可能作为治疗胶质瘤的治疗性抑制剂具有应用前景。
